Centauri’s CEN delivers broad clinical access across hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory providers nationwide. By connecting through Carequality and the eHealth Exchange trust networks, CEN supports scalable coordination, clinical record retrieval, and care-transition workflows — giving organizations a single, reliable path to nationwide interoperability.

Participate in the Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement™ (TEFCA®) through MedAllies, a Qualified Health Information Network®, and future-proof your exchange strategy with a single, governed connection to nationwide interoperability. QHIN™ connectivity enables secure information sharing across organizations and care settings — supporting care coordination, transitions, and nationwide exchange while reducing integration complexity across the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
